instruction.text: A garden has flowers planted in sections. <mat>1/8</mat> of the flowers are roses, <mat>16/24</mat> are tulips, and the rest are daisies. What fraction of the garden is planted with daisies?

atoms.b: Therefore, <mat><gap>5</gap>/24</mat> of the garden is planted with daisies.

instruction.text: During a week, <mat>3/15</mat> of Rashid’s time is spent on exercise, <mat>2/5</mat> on study, and the rest on leisure. What fraction of his time does Rashid spend on leisure?

atoms.b: Therefore, <mat><gap>2</gap>/5</mat> of his time is spent on leisure.

instruction.text: In a school, <mat>2/9</mat> of the pupils take the bus, and <mat>1/3</mat> walk to school. The rest use other means of transport. What fraction of the pupils use other means of transport?

atoms.b: pupils who walk or take the bus: <mat>2/9+3/9=<gap>5</gap>/9</mat>
Therefore, <mat><gap>4</gap>/<gap>9</gap></mat> of the pupils use other means of transport.

instruction.text: In a survey, <mat>8/12</mat> of the respondents preferred reading, <mat>1/4</mat> enjoyed sports, and the rest were fans of video games. What fraction of the respondents were fans of video games?

atoms.b: Therefore, <mat><gap>1</gap>/<gap>12</gap></mat> of the respondents were fans of video games.

instruction.text: A class is divided into groups for a project. <mat>3/7</mat> are researching history, <mat>2/5</mat> are working on science, and the rest are focusing on literature. What fraction of the class is focusing on literature?

atoms.b: Therefore, <mat><gap>6</gap>/<gap>35</gap></mat> of the class are focusing on literature.

instruction.text: A batch of cookies is divided into <mat>8/18</mat> with chocolate chips, <mat>1/6</mat> with nuts, and the rest are plain. What fraction of the batch is plain?

atoms.b: nut cookies and chocolate chip cookies: <mat>8/18+3/18=<gap>11</gap>/18</mat>
Therefore, <mat><gap>7</gap>/<gap>18</gap></mat> of the batch is plain.

instruction.text: A film critic specialises in a few genres. <mat>2/4</mat> of the films he watches are comedies, <mat>2/5</mat> are thrillers, and the rest are romances. What fraction of their watched films are romances?

atoms.b: Therefore, <mat><gap>2</gap>/20</mat> of the films they review are romances.

instruction.text: In a class, <mat>1/6</mat> of the students are on the football team, <mat>1/4</mat> are on the basketball team, and the rest participate in the chess club. What fraction of the students participate in the chess club?

atoms.b: Therefore, <mat><gap>7</gap>/<gap>12</gap></mat> of the students participate in the chess club.
